subject: Talking Points for Today’s Meeting
context: Short, warm note to a client owner ahead of a meeting he is coaching her through.
author: Yancey Dawson
body:
Hey Vee,

I put together some talking points for today's meeting. You'll likely won't use them today since Q and I will be walking through the meeting structure and agenda.

These are designed specifically for you as the owner focused on the questions you should be asking James about weekly performance. I'll be sending James his own set of guidance separately, so he knows what to prepare and understands the expectations heading into Wednesday's meeting.

I'll work closely with both of you and help walk through the meeting step by step the first few times until we get a solid rhythm.

Let me know if you want to tweak anything before the meeting.

Thanks,
Yancey
